      ⚙️ Dashboard Settings

      📄 Get Sheet Template

      Data Links

      Expects columns: Date, ID; daily Warmup, Agenda, Reminders, Message; sticky Title, Start, End, Roster, EQ, Standards, Resources, Ticker (shown in the Market panel), and optional Color. Blank sticky cells keep the last value for that ID. Optional Standards tab: codes typed in Standards show their full text and fill in the EQ. Whichever you changed last wins: a new code with a blank EQ uses the tab's EQ, and a typed EQ wins until you change Standards again.

      Expects columns: Status (ACTIVE to show everyone, TEACHER_ONLY to hide just from Student Mode links while keeping it on your own dashboard), Classes (optional: blank shows the pack in every class; otherwise class names or period IDs, separated by commas, on the pack's first row), ID, Type, Title, Category, Prompt, Answer, Value. For the Reinforcement Lab (Type=reinforcement), Prompt holds the schedule (FR-5, VR-5, FI-8, VI-8, or RANDOM) and Value holds the round length in seconds.

      Look & Names

      School colors, starting looks, fonts and pinned tools. Same as the gear on the board.

      🎮 Game Settings

      📄 Class Recap PDF

      Normally offered automatically when a class period ends. Use this to generate one for the currently active period anytime - handy for testing, or if you dismissed the end-of-class prompt earlier.

      ☁️ Live Sync (optional)

      Connects to a small script (Code.gs) on your own spreadsheet so Student Mode devices see your phone status, timer, and notes, and Reinforcement Lab scores reach your scoreboard. Leave blank if you don't use those.

      The settings file copies your theme, settings, sheet links, and Live Sync secret to another computer. It doesn't include points or attendance (the Class Recap PDF covers those). Keep it private, since it contains your secret.

      👋 Welcome to Your Dashboard

      This dashboard is powered by two Google Sheets that you own and edit: one for your daily schedule, agenda and roster, and one for game content. Until you connect one, you're looking at sample demo data so you can explore safely.

      1. Grab the template below, then in Google Sheets go to File → Make a copy.

      2. Fill in your schedule, then File → Share → Publish to web, choose CSV, and copy that link.

      3. Paste the link into Settings → Data Links and save.
